committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 17 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid spend fell to $67.69 last7 from $135.69 prior7, with clicks down to 10 from 18 and CPC at $6.77, close to the test's roughly $6 design. The $600 credit is now at $0 remaining and the campaign shows PAUSED, so the decision rule (cost per qualified enquiry under $480 and at least one qualified booking) now governs whether paid search restarts.

Search Console data only runs through 14 Nov, two days behind yesterday (Mon 16), so clicks or impressions since then aren't visible yet. No external account changes were logged in the last 24 hours or 7 days, so the numbers since the credit ran out are not contaminated by outside edits.

Since the test began, raw paid clicks have reached 108 with 16 ask_cta_click and 5 quick_question_click events against zero review_cta_click, so visitors are choosing the lighter question-form step over booking the 60-minute review entirely.

Organic Search held at 10 sessions versus 9 prior, the only unpaid signal worth trusting while Paid Search dropped from 17 to 10. AI Assistant referrals stayed at zero again, so there's still no visible answer-engine traffic to report.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks have reached 108, past the 75-click checkpoint: check the test log now for relevant and qualified counts. If relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag is live, and the page stays frozen past click 25 with only broken-page fixes allowed.

The $600 credit is fully spent (creditRemainingExGst at $0) and the campaign already shows PAUSED: confirm against the rule, paid search stays paused unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.

generate_lead has fired 3 times since the test started: check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source details and grade each against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) in the test log.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin saved per week and 99.6% success and need updating to match current site stats.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding.
